subject: cos-d
title: COS.D.------PART.
description: Chart on book p. 131 (ALT(FT)II-25). COS-D (cosmic dictates) is the subject; PART (participation) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight), TR (transformation) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From AFI: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: AF-NT (affinity nature). From TR: EXP-CONT-1 (expansion condition (composite focus)). From SPT-DY: APL-DY. From APL-DY: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From EXB-H-OR: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics).
